fusions.name: Sporing Lines
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 6 damage and is [Diseased], so healing does less for them, for 6 seconds. Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

fusions.name: Root Stitch
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 14 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Underlying Mat
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of strands where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, healing you receive is 30% stronger for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
